meta.name: ui-ux-pro-max
meta.description: UI/UX design intelligence for web and mobile. Searchable local database with 84 styles, 192 color palettes, 74 font pairings, 192 product types, 98 UX guidelines, 104 icon entries, 16 GSAP motion presets, and 25 chart types across 22 stacks (React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, Svelte, Astro, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Jetpack Compose, Angular, Laravel, JavaFX, WPF, WinUI, Avalonia, Uno Platform, UWP, Three.js, and HTML/CSS). Use when designing, building, or reviewing UI: pages, components, color schemes, typography, layout, accessibility, animation, or data visualization.

copy.tagline: 随时查阅界面风格、配色、字体与动效规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计网页或应用界面，想快速找到合适的风格与规范。
copy.tagline_en: Look up UI styles, palettes, fonts, and motion presets on demand.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build websites or apps and need quick design guidance.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 做界面设计时会先查一个本地设计规则库，按优先级给出风格、配色、字体、布局、可访问性、动画等建议，还能生成整套设计系统方案。
howto.when: 当任务是设计或审查界面，例如新建页面、调整配色排版、检查可访问性等 UI 相关需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个美妆水疗网站的首页，做成一套设计系统。
say.note: Claude 会生成配色、字体、布局等整套方案。

say.text: 给我推荐适合娱乐应用的鲜艳配色方案。
say.note: Claude 会查询数据库给出配色建议。

say.text: 审查一下这个移动端页面的可访问性问题，列出要改的地方。
say.note: Claude 会按可访问性规则逐项检查。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude consults a local design-rule database when working on web/mobile UI, giving priority-ranked advice on style, color, typography, layout, accessibility, and animation. It can also generate a complete design-system proposal.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the task involves UI structure, visual design, or UX review—such as designing new pages, adjusting color/typography, or checking accessibility.

say_en.text: Design a beauty spa homepage and make it a full design system.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a complete design proposal.

say_en.text: Suggest a vibrant color palette for an entertainment app.
say_en.note: Claude will query the palette database.

say_en.text: Check this mobile page for accessibility issues and list fixes.
say_en.note: Claude will apply the UX accessibility rules.
